Answer: **D**. A hoe cultivates soil.

Objective: Demonstrate Agri-Fishery Arts: A hoe cultivates soil.

Sources: [tle](https://www.deped.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/EPP-CG.pdf), [fish](https://www.fao.org/fishery/static/FAO_Training/FAO_Training/General/x6709e/x6709e02.htm)

### 4. Fish obtain respiratory oxygen mainly from where?

ID: KAT-TLE-37-04 · easy · remember

- A. Fish feed alone.
- B. Sunlight directly.
- C. Dry soil.
- D. Dissolved oxygen in water.

Answer: **D**. Gills extract dissolved oxygen.

Objective: Demonstrate Agri-Fishery Arts: Gills extract dissolved oxygen.

Sources: [tle](https://www.deped.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/EPP-CG.pdf), [fish](https://www.fao.org/fishery/static/FAO_Training/FAO_Training/General/x6709e/x6709e02.htm)

### 5. What is irrigation?

ID: KAT-TLE-37-05 · easy · remember

- A. Packaging finished cloth.
- B. Painting tools.
- C. Removing all seeds.
- D. Supplying water to crops.

Answer: **D**. Irrigation supplements crop water.

Objective: Demonstrate Agri-Fishery Arts: Irrigation supplements crop water.

Sources: [tle](https://www.deped.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/EPP-CG.pdf), [fish](https://www.fao.org/fishery/static/FAO_Training/FAO_Training/General/x6709e/x6709e02.htm)

### 6. What is a seedling?

ID: KAT-TLE-37-06 · easy · remember

- A. A young plant.
- B. A mature harvested fish.
- C. A pruning tool.
- D. A soil mineral only.

Answer: **A**. A seedling is an early plant stage.

Objective: Demonstrate Agri-Fishery Arts: A seedling is an early plant stage.

Sources: [tle](https://www.deped.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/EPP-CG.pdf), [fish](https://www.fao.org/fishery/static/FAO_Training/FAO_Training/General/x6709e/x6709e02.htm)

### 7. Why provide drainage for many garden crops?

ID: KAT-TLE-37-07 · medium · understand

- A. To remove every nutrient instantly.
- B. To avoid prolonged waterlogging around roots.
- C. To eliminate all soil moisture.
- D. To prevent all root growth.

Answer: **B**. Excess standing water can impair roots.

Objective: Demonstrate Agri-Fishery Arts: Excess standing water can impair roots.

Sources: [tle](https://www.deped.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/EPP-CG.pdf), [fish](https://www.fao.org/fishery/static/FAO_Training/FAO_Training/General/x6709e/x6709e02.htm)

### 8. Why space seedlings appropriately?

ID: KAT-TLE-37-08 · medium · apply

- A. To guarantee identical yields.
- B. To reduce excessive competition for resources.
- C. To eliminate the need for soil.
- D. To stop sunlight reaching leaves.

Answer: **B**. Plants compete for light, water and nutrients.

Objective: Demonstrate Agri-Fishery Arts: Plants compete for light, water and nutrients.

Sources: [tle](https://www.deped.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/EPP-CG.pdf), [fish](https://www.fao.org/fishery/static/FAO_Training/FAO_Training/General/x6709e/x6709e02.htm)

### 9. Why acclimate young plants before transplanting?

ID: KAT-TLE-37-09 · medium · understand

- A. To halt all growth permanently.
- B. To reduce stress from changed conditions.
- C. To replace healthy roots.
- D. To ensure no watering is needed.

Answer: **B**. Gradual adjustment can improve establishment.

Objective: Demonstrate Agri-Fishery Arts: Gradual adjustment can improve establishment.

Sources: [tle](https://www.deped.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/EPP-CG.pdf), [fish](https://www.fao.org/fishery/static/FAO_Training/FAO_Training/General/x6709e/x6709e02.htm)

### 10. What is a suitable use of mature compost?

ID: KAT-TLE-37-10 · medium · apply

- A. Improving soil organic matter and structure.
- B. Replacing all soil with fresh plastic.
- C. Painting harvested vegetables.
- D. Disinfecting fish through direct ingestion.

Answer: **A**. Organic matter can improve soil properties.

Objective: Demonstrate Agri-Fishery Arts: Organic matter can improve soil properties.

Sources: [tle](https://www.deped.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/EPP-CG.pdf), [fish](https://www.fao.org/fishery/static/FAO_Training/FAO_Training/General/x6709e/x6709e02.htm)

### 11. Fish gather at the surface gasping. What should be checked urgently?

ID: KAT-TLE-37-11 · medium · understand

- A. The storage room's font.
- B. The pond sign's color.
- C. Dissolved oxygen and water quality.
- D. The farm's logo.

Answer: **C**. Gasping can indicate inadequate oxygen.

Objective: Demonstrate Agri-Fishery Arts: Gasping can indicate inadequate oxygen.

Sources: [tle](https://www.deped.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/EPP-CG.pdf), [fish](https://www.fao.org/fishery/static/FAO_Training/FAO_Training/General/x6709e/x6709e02.htm)

### 12. Why avoid overfeeding fish?

ID: KAT-TLE-37-12 · medium · apply

- A. Feed cannot decompose.
- B. Fish never need nutrients.
- C. Uneaten feed can degrade water quality.
- D. More feed always produces cleaner water.

Answer: **C**. Organic waste can increase oxygen demand.

Objective: Demonstrate Agri-Fishery Arts: Organic waste can increase oxygen demand.

Sources: [tle](https://www.deped.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/EPP-CG.pdf), [fish](https://www.fao.org/fishery/static/FAO_Training/FAO_Training/General/x6709e/x6709e02.htm)

### 13. Why monitor pond temperature?

ID: KAT-TLE-37-13 · medium · understand

- A. It determines every fish's exact age.
- B. It affects oxygen availability and fish metabolism.
- C. It prevents all disease automatically.
- D. It replaces all water tests.

Answer: **B**. Temperature influences several important pond processes.

Objective: Demonstrate Agri-Fishery Arts: Temperature influences several important pond processes.

Sources: [tle](https://www.deped.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/EPP-CG.pdf), [fish](https://www.fao.org/fishery/static/FAO_Training/FAO_Training/General/x6709e/x6709e02.htm)

### 14. What does integrated pest management emphasize?

ID: KAT-TLE-37-14 · medium · apply

- A. Monitoring and combining appropriate controls.
- B. Spraying any chemical without checking pests.
- C. Using one method regardless of evidence.
- D. Destroying every organism in the field.

Answer: **A**. IPM uses informed, complementary management measures.

Objective: Demonstrate Agri-Fishery Arts: IPM uses informed, complementary management measures.

Sources: [tle](https://www.deped.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/EPP-CG.pdf), [fish](https://www.fao.org/fishery/static/FAO_Training/FAO_Training/General/x6709e/x6709e02.htm)

### 15. Why clean and store farm tools properly?

ID: KAT-TLE-37-15 · medium · understand

- A. To make damaged tools safe automatically.
- B. To maintain function and reduce avoidable hazards.
- C. To remove the need for training.
- D. To guarantee all crops survive.

Answer: **B**. Maintenance supports safe efficient work.

Objective: Demonstrate Agri-Fishery Arts: Maintenance supports safe efficient work.

Sources: [tle](https://www.deped.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/EPP-CG.pdf), [fish](https://www.fao.org/fishery/static/FAO_Training/FAO_Training/General/x6709e/x6709e02.htm)

### 16. What should farm records include?

ID: KAT-TLE-37-16 · medium · apply

- A. Inputs, dates, activities and yields.
- B. Only decorative drawings.
- C. Invented harvest totals.
- D. Only workers' favorite colors.

Answer: **A**. Records help evaluate operations and results.

Objective: Demonstrate Agri-Fishery Arts: Records help evaluate operations and results.

Sources: [tle](https://www.deped.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/EPP-CG.pdf), [fish](https://www.fao.org/fishery/static/FAO_Training/FAO_Training/General/x6709e/x6709e02.htm)

### 17. After an algal bloom dies, fish become distressed. What mechanism should be investigated?

ID: KAT-TLE-37-17 · hard · analyze

- A. Dead algae creating unlimited oxygen at night.
- B. Water becoming solid automatically.
- C. Fish no longer needing oxygen.
- D. Decomposition consuming dissolved oxygen.

Answer: **D**. Microbial decay can reduce oxygen levels.

Objective: Demonstrate Agri-Fishery Arts: Microbial decay can reduce oxygen levels.

Sources: [tle](https://www.deped.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/EPP-CG.pdf), [fish](https://www.fao.org/fishery/static/FAO_Training/FAO_Training/General/x6709e/x6709e02.htm)

### 18. A farmer changes crop variety and irrigation together, then yield rises. What can be concluded?

ID: KAT-TLE-37-18 · hard · evaluate

- A. Irrigation cannot affect yield.
- B. No yield comparison is possible at all.
- C. Both may contribute; their separate effects are unresolved.
- D. Only the variety caused the increase.

Answer: **C**. Multiple changes prevent isolating one cause.

Objective: Demonstrate Agri-Fishery Arts: Multiple changes prevent isolating one cause.

Sources: [tle](https://www.deped.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/EPP-CG.pdf), [fish](https://www.fao.org/fishery/static/FAO_Training/FAO_Training/General/x6709e/x6709e02.htm)

### 19. Why is excessive fertilizer not always beneficial?

ID: KAT-TLE-37-19 · hard · analyze

- A. More fertilizer guarantees higher profit.
- B. Plants grow without any limits.
- C. It can harm plants and contaminate surrounding water.
- D. Fertilizer can never leave soil.

Answer: **C**. Excess inputs can create costs and environmental harm.

Objective: Demonstrate Agri-Fishery Arts: Excess inputs can create costs and environmental harm.

Sources: [tle](https://www.deped.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/EPP-CG.pdf), [fish](https://www.fao.org/fishery/static/FAO_Training/FAO_Training/General/x6709e/x6709e02.htm)

### 20. A pond's water looks clear. Does that prove it is safe for fish?

ID: KAT-TLE-37-20 · hard · evaluate

- A. Yes; ammonia is always visible.
- B. Yes; clarity proves adequate oxygen.
- C. No; all clear water is poisonous.
- D. No; important chemical conditions are not established by appearance.

Answer: **D**. Water quality needs appropriate observation and testing.

Objective: Demonstrate Agri-Fishery Arts: Water quality needs appropriate observation and testing.

Sources: [tle](https://www.deped.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/EPP-CG.pdf), [fish](https://www.fao.org/fishery/static/FAO_Training/FAO_Training/General/x6709e/x6709e02.htm)

### 8. Which password practice is strongest?

- D. Use unique long passwords or passphrases.

Answer: **D**. Uniqueness and length reduce common password risks.

Sources: [ict](https://openstax.org/books/workplace-software-skills/pages/1-2-computer-hardware-and-networks), [ictsecurity](https://openstax.org/books/workplace-software-skills/pages/1-4-safety-security-privacy-and-the-ethical-use-of-technology), [tle](https://www.deped.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/EPP-CG.pdf)

### 9. An email asks urgently for login details through an unfamiliar link. What is prudent?

ID: KAT-TLE-35-09 · medium · understand

- A. Forward the password to everyone.
- B. Disable all security settings.
- C. Verify the request through a trusted independent channel.
- D. Enter credentials immediately.

Answer: **C**. Independent verification helps detect phishing.

Sources: [ict](https://openstax.org/books/workplace-software-skills/pages/1-2-computer-hardware-and-networks), [ictsecurity](https://openstax.org/books/workplace-software-skills/pages/1-4-safety-security-privacy-and-the-ethical-use-of-technology), [tle](https://www.deped.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/EPP-CG.pdf)

### 14. What does a file extension commonly indicate?

ID: KAT-TLE-35-14 · medium · apply

- A. Its owner's age.
- B. The file's format or associated type.

### 17. A file has a familiar extension but came from an unknown sender. Is it automatically safe?

### 1. Which component executes general program instructions?

- A. RAM

### 2. A network connecting distant sites is what?

ID: KAT135-MISCELLANEOUS-131-02 · easy · remember

- B. Router
- C. LAN
- D. Switch

Answer: **A**. A WAN spans wider geographic distances.

ID: KAT135-MISCELLANEOUS-131-04 · easy · remember

- B. LAN

Answer: **D**. A switch links local devices.

ID: KAT135-MISCELLANEOUS-131-05 · easy · remember

- B. IP address

ID: KAT135-MISCELLANEOUS-131-06 · easy · remember

ID: KAT135-MISCELLANEOUS-131-08 · medium · understand

- B. DNS

### 9. Which private block includes 10.5.2.1?

ID: KAT135-MISCELLANEOUS-131-09 · medium · understand

- A. 172.16.0.0/12
- B. 127.0.0.0/8
- C. 192.168.0.0/16
- D. 10.0.0.0/8

Answer: **D**. The first octet lies within 10/8.

### 10. Which private block includes 172.20.1.1?

ID: KAT135-MISCELLANEOUS-131-10 · medium · understand

- A. 192.168.0.0/16
- B. 127.0.0.0/8
- C. 10.0.0.0/8
- D. 172.16.0.0/12

Answer: **D**. 172.16 through 172.31 belongs to this block.

### 11. Which private block includes 192.168.4.2?

ID: KAT135-MISCELLANEOUS-131-11 · medium · understand

- A. 127.0.0.0/8
- B. 10.0.0.0/8
- C. 192.168.0.0/16
- D. 172.16.0.0/12

Answer: **C**. 192.168 belongs to the private /16 block.

ID: KAT135-MISCELLANEOUS-131-12 · medium · understand

- A. 192.168.0.0/16
- B. 172.16.0.0/12
- C. 127.0.0.0/8
- D. 10.0.0.0/8

Answer: **C**. 127/8 refers to the local host loopback function.

### 13. What dotted mask corresponds to /24?

ID: KAT135-MISCELLANEOUS-131-13 · medium · understand

- A. Different subnets
- B. 254 host addresses
- C. 256 addresses
- D. 255.255.255.0

Answer: **D**. Twenty-four leading bits are ones.

Objective: Demonstrate Networking, Cabling & IP Addressing: Twenty-four leading bits are ones.

Sources: [current-networks](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc1918.html), [current-ip](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc4632.html), [current-computer](https://openstax.org/books/workplace-software-skills/pages/1-2-computer-hardware-and-networks)

### 14. How many total IPv4 addresses are in a /24 block?

ID: KAT135-MISCELLANEOUS-131-14 · medium · understand

- A. 255.255.255.0
- B. Different subnets
- C. 256 addresses
- D. 254 host addresses

Answer: **C**. Eight host bits give 2⁸ addresses.

Objective: Demonstrate Networking, Cabling & IP Addressing: Eight host bits give 2⁸ addresses.

Sources: [current-networks](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc1918.html), [current-ip](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc4632.html), [current-computer](https://openstax.org/books/workplace-software-skills/pages/1-2-computer-hardware-and-networks)

### 15. In an ordinary /24 subnet reserving network and broadcast addresses, how many host addresses remain?

ID: KAT135-MISCELLANEOUS-131-15 · medium · understand

- A. Different subnets
- B. 254 host addresses
- C. 256 addresses
- D. 255.255.255.0

Answer: **B**. 256 minus two equals 254.

Objective: Demonstrate Networking, Cabling & IP Addressing: 256 minus two equals 254.

Sources: [current-networks](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc1918.html), [current-ip](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc4632.html), [current-computer](https://openstax.org/books/workplace-software-skills/pages/1-2-computer-hardware-and-networks)

### 16. With /24 masks, 192.168.1.10 and 192.168.2.10 are what?

ID: KAT135-MISCELLANEOUS-131-16 · medium · understand

- A. Different subnets
- B. 255.255.255.0
- C. 256 addresses
- D. 254 host addresses

Answer: **A**. Their first twenty-four bits differ.

Objective: Demonstrate Networking, Cabling & IP Addressing: Their first twenty-four bits differ.

Sources: [current-networks](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc1918.html), [current-ip](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc4632.html), [current-computer](https://openstax.org/books/workplace-software-skills/pages/1-2-computer-hardware-and-networks)

### 17. A device shows no link indication. What is a sensible initial check?

ID: KAT135-MISCELLANEOUS-131-17 · hard · analyze

- A. Match cable and port standards
- B. Ping failure alone does not prove total network failure
- C. Check the physical link first
- D. Verify addressing and routing together

Answer: **C**. Cable and port conditions can prevent any link.

Objective: Demonstrate Networking, Cabling & IP Addressing: Cable and port conditions can prevent any link.

Sources: [current-networks](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc1918.html), [current-ip](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc4632.html), [current-computer](https://openstax.org/books/workplace-software-skills/pages/1-2-computer-hardware-and-networks)

### 18. Why can a reachable service exist even when echo requests receive no reply?

ID: KAT135-MISCELLANEOUS-131-18 · hard · analyze

- A. Match cable and port standards
- B. Ping failure alone does not prove total network failure
- C. Verify addressing and routing together
- D. Check the physical link first

Answer: **B**. ICMP responses may be blocked or disabled.

Objective: Demonstrate Networking, Cabling & IP Addressing: ICMP responses may be blocked or disabled.

Sources: [current-networks](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc1918.html), [current-ip](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc4632.html), [current-computer](https://openstax.org/books/workplace-software-skills/pages/1-2-computer-hardware-and-networks)

### 19. Why is a connector's visual fit insufficient to establish cable suitability?

ID: KAT135-MISCELLANEOUS-131-19 · hard · analyze

- A. Match cable and port standards
- B. Ping failure alone does not prove total network failure
- C. Check the physical link first
- D. Verify addressing and routing together

Answer: **A**. Wiring and transmission specifications matter.

Objective: Demonstrate Networking, Cabling & IP Addressing: Wiring and transmission specifications matter.

Sources: [current-networks](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc1918.html), [current-ip](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc4632.html), [current-computer](https://openstax.org/books/workplace-software-skills/pages/1-2-computer-hardware-and-networks)

### 20. Why can a correct-looking IP address still fail to reach another network?

ID: KAT135-MISCELLANEOUS-131-20 · hard · analyze

- A. Match cable and port standards
- B. Verify addressing and routing together
- C. Check the physical link first
- D. Ping failure alone does not prove total network failure

Answer: **B**. Mask, gateway and routes also affect delivery.

Objective: Demonstrate Networking, Cabling & IP Addressing: Mask, gateway and routes also affect delivery.

Sources: [current-networks](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc1918.html), [current-ip](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc4632.html), [current-computer](https://openstax.org/books/workplace-software-skills/pages/1-2-computer-hardware-and-networks)

### 5. Which protective element opens a circuit by melting under excessive current?

Answer: **A**. Work-holding and safe procedures reduce exposure.

Sources: [tools](https://www.osha.gov/hand-power-tools), [workshopsafety](https://www.osha.gov/sites/default/files/publications/OSHA3080.pdf), [tle](https://www.deped.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/EPP-CG.pdf)

### 19. Why is selecting PPE alone insufficient for workshop safety?

ID: KAT-TLE-38-19 · hard · analyze

- A. All hazards are identical.
- B. Hazard control, maintenance and safe procedures are also needed.
- C. Training replaces every guard.
- D. PPE is always useless.

Answer: **B**. PPE is only one layer of protection.

Objective: Demonstrate Industrial Arts: PPE is only one layer of protection.

Sources: [tools](https://www.osha.gov/hand-power-tools), [workshopsafety](https://www.osha.gov/sites/default/files/publications/OSHA3080.pdf), [tle](https://www.deped.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/EPP-CG.pdf)

### 20. A drawing and measured workpiece disagree. What should happen before assembly?

ID: KAT-TLE-38-20 · hard · evaluate

- A. Force parts together immediately.
- B. Verify dimensions and resolve the discrepancy.
- C. Hide the measurement.
- D. Assume the drawing cannot be wrong.

Answer: **B**. Checking avoids propagating an unresolved error.

Objective: Demonstrate Industrial Arts: Checking avoids propagating an unresolved error.

Sources: [tools](https://www.osha.gov/hand-power-tools), [workshopsafety](https://www.osha.gov/sites/default/files/publications/OSHA3080.pdf), [tle](https://www.deped.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/EPP-CG.pdf)
